entities.name: Héli Chatelain
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Héli Chatelain was a Swiss linguist and Protestant missionary. He worked with rural populations in Angola, where he founded a mission and, in particular, fought against the slavery that still ravaged the country in the 19th century.
